presets.name: Double Protein Plate
presets.blurb: Double teriyaki chicken with half rice and half greens. 875 kcal, 76g protein.
presets.sourceNote: Composition and published 875 kcal / 76 g protein from Panda Express's live Balanced Protein Plates builder at Golden Link Blvd. & E Aurora Rd (reviewed 2026-08-31). The builder offers Teriyaki Sauce separately and does not include it in the plate's displayed total, so the preset omits it.
